newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's president starts first visit to Africa.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's president starts first visit to Africa.

text.p: Portuguese President Jorge Sampaio arrived in Mozambique on Monday to start a one-week visit, Portuguese radio said.
It is his first official trip to one of the country's former African colonies.
Sampaio, who took office in March 1996, is accompanied by a 168-strong delegation that includes three government ministers and 36 businessmen.
Mozambique, which won independence in 1975, forms part of the seven-country Community of Portuguese-Speaking Countries which was launched in July last year in Lisbon.
But its decision also to join the British Commonwealth stoked concerns in Portugal that its influence over its former domain could wane.
